# Trang Tâm sự + logo termux.io.vn — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add a `/tam-su/` topic page generated by `sync.js`, add a KIE-generated logo (favicon + brand mark + og:image), and add per-page meta descriptions.

**Architecture:** Extend `scripts/sync.js` — the single source of generated HTML — to classify stories by keyword into topics, emit `tam-su/index.html`, wire a `Tâm sự` nav link into every page shell, and write a `<head>` block with description/icon/og. Reuse the already-present-but-unused CSS list classes. Generate the logo once via `pwterm imagine` (KIE), convert with ffmpeg.

**Tech Stack:** Node 26 (`node:sqlite`), ffmpeg (ICO muxer), pwterm `imagine` (KIE MiniMax model), GitHub Pages.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-tam-su-logo-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- `posts/` and `assets/img/` are `rm -rf`'d each sync — logo must live at `assets/logo.png` + `favicon.ico` (repo root), never inside those two dirs.
- URLs carry `?v=` from `assetVersion()` — `logo.png` must join its file list; `favicon.ico` carries no `?v=` (accepted shortcut).
- `shell(title, body, prefix, lockZoom, bare)` serves 3 page kinds: home (`bare`, prefix `''`), post (prefix `'../../'`), new topic page (prefix `'../'`). Chrome links use `prefix`, never hardcoded paths.
- Home has **no header** (bare) → the new-page link goes in `.feed-topbar`; posts keep a single theme toggle (in reader-topbar) — no second toggle may appear.
- All copy below is public and approved; ship it verbatim.
- KIE is already configured (`~/.pwterm/settings.json`, `available: true`), outputs **jpeg only**. `pwterm` runs at HEAD with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0`. No ImageMagick; ffmpeg + python3 available.
- Logo budget: max **2 batches = 8 KIE images**. If all 8 are rejected → stop generating, draw a hand SVG (approach 2C).
- Publish = sync → test → `git add -A && commit && git push origin main` (user requires push).

## Review Focus

- **A story whose `lead` is empty or missing** — every page must still get a valid description; fall back to `SITE_DESC` rather than an empty `content=""` (task 2).
- **A story matching two topics** — first-topic-wins order (Tình yêu before Hôn nhân before Đời sống); no story appears twice (task 1).
- **Cover image missing (skipImage)** — the topic-page card must still render title + meta without an `<img>` (task 3).
- **The topic page must not render a second theme toggle** when it is a bare/post-like page, and must not double-toggle with the reader-topbar (task 4).
- **logo.png absent on disk** — the build must still succeed and emit no broken `<img>`; only present when the file exists (task 6).

- [ ] **Step 2: Run the test, verify it fails** (`topicOf is not defined`)

Run: `node --test scripts/sync.test.js`
Expected: FAIL

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `topicOf` + `TOPICS`**

```js
const TOPICS = [
  { name: 'Tình yêu',          words: ['yêu', 'rung động', 'người yêu', 'hẹn hò', 'crush', 'tình yêu'] },
  { name: 'Hôn nhân & gia đình', words: ['cưới', 'kết hôn', 'chồng', 'vợ', 'mẹ chồng', 'con dâu', 'gia đình', 'đám cưới', 'lấy nhau'] },
  { name: 'Đời sống',          words: ['nghèo', 'tiền', 'công việc', 'cuộc sống', 'hoàn cảnh', 'đời'] },
];

function topicOf(title, lead) {
  const haystack = `${String(title || '')} ${String(lead || '')}`.toLowerCase();
  for (const topic of TOPICS) {
    if (topic.words.some((word) => haystack.includes(word))) return topic.name;
  }
  return 'Chuyện khác';
}
```

Expected: PASS (both new tests)

## Self-Review

**Spec coverage:** Goals 1–5 → tasks 1,3 (topic page), 4 (nav), 2 (descriptions), 6 (logo). Constraints → tasks 2 (prefix-correct head), 4 (single toggle, feed-brand preserved), 5 (hash), 6 (logo outside wiped dirs). Pipeline §4 → task 6. Tests §7 → tasks 1–4, 6. Publish §8 → task 7. All covered.

**Review Focus tests:** empty `lead` → task 2 step 2 test 2. Two topics → task 1 step 1 test 2. Missing cover → task 3 step 1 test 3. Double toggle → task 4 step 1 tests 4–5. Missing logo → task 6 step 1.

**Type consistency:** `topicOf(title, lead)` defined task 1, used task 3. `shell(...)` gains 6th param `description` (task 2) and 7th `showToggle` (task 4) — task 3's call is written with 6 args, task 4 extends it to 7. `hasLogo` defined task 6, used in home markup.
